extracted.intended_audience: philanthropists, foundation trustees, and public benefactors
extracted.subtask_description: Principles and operational standards for making large philanthropic gifts, establishing pension funds and public trusts, and structuring endowments and trustee responsibilities, illustrated by Andrew Carnegie's practices and trust deeds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Systematized application and graduated grants
rubrics_metrics.description: A printed schedule requiring answers to many questions has now to be filled and returned before action is taken. The department is now perfectly systematized and works admirably because we graduate the gift according to the size of the church.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Require a formal application form with sufficient information to evaluate requests; use a graduated scale of grant amounts tied to recipient size/capacity so gifts are proportional and administrable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recipient cost-sharing requirement (matching contribution)
rubrics_metrics.description: I asked each congregation to pay one half of the desired new organ.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Require recipients to contribute a substantial portion (e.g., 50%) of the project's cost to ensure needed and reasonable expenditure, recipient commitment, and prudent use of funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure gifts address clear need and reasonable expenditure
rubrics_metrics.description: In requiring the congregation to pay one half the cost of better instruments, there is assurance of needed and reasonable expenditure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structure grants so they target genuine needs and include mechanisms (cost-sharing, review of prior assets) to avoid wasteful or demoralizing expenditures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pension beneficiary selection: known, deserving, confidential
rubrics_metrics.description: Not one person have I ever placed upon the pension list that did not fully deserve assistance. ... It is a real roll of honor and mutual affection. All are worthy. There is no publicity about it. No one knows who is embraced. Not a word is ever breathed to others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select pension beneficiaries based on personal knowledge of character and need; keep distributions private to preserve dignity; provide modest sums sufficient to remove maintenance anxieties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of targeted funds for specific communities or former employees
rubrics_metrics.description: The Railroad Pension Fund ... benefits the worthy railroad men who served under me when I was superintendent on the Pennsylvania, or their widows, who need help. ... the four-million-dollar fund I gave for workmen in the mills (Steel Workers' Pensions) embraces hundreds ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create funds aimed at well-defined beneficiary groups (former employees, widows) with eligibility tied to service or affiliation to ensure focused and accountable giving.

rubrics_metrics.name: Founding large public institutions upon appropriate invitation or authority
rubrics_metrics.description: When Andrew D. White and Mr. Holls ... suggested that I offer the funds needed for a Temple of Peace at The Hague, I informed them that I never could be so presumptuous; that if the Government of the Netherlands informed me of its desire to have such a temple and hoped I would furnish the means, the request would be favorably considered. ... Finally the Dutch Government did make application ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For major public or international projects, act only after formal request or clear indication of desire from the relevant government or authoritative body to avoid presumption and ensure political legitimacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear trust deed objectives with measurable social aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Trust deed direction: 'To bring into the monotonous lives of the toiling masses of Dunfermline, more "of sweetness and light," to give to them--especially the young--some charm, some happiness, some elevating conditions of life ...' If this be the fruit of your labors, you will have succeeded; if not, you will have failed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Draft trust documents that articulate explicit social objectives and desired outcomes so trustees can evaluate success against those stated ends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide a sustainable endowment invested to produce ongoing support
rubrics_metrics.description: When they heard that half a million sterling in bonds, bearing five per cent interest, was also to go to them for the benefit of Dunfermline, they were surprised.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fund public gifts with a capital endowment (e.g., invested bonds) whose yield covers ongoing operating, maintenance, and program costs to ensure perpetual benefit rather than one-time expense.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select public-spirited, capable trustees and organize them properly
rubrics_metrics.description: As the possessor of the Park and the Glen I had a chance to find out what, if anything, money could do for the good of the masses of a community, if placed in the hands of a body of public-spirited citizens. Dr. Ross was taken into my confidence so far as Pittencrieff Park was concerned, and with his advice certain men intended for a body of trustees were agreed upon and invited to Skibo to organize.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose trustees with demonstrated public spirit and relevant judgment; involve trusted advisors in trustee selection and properly organize a governing body to administer the gift in keeping with the trust's mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Donor modesty and restraint in initiating grand projects
rubrics_metrics.description: I informed them that I never could be so presumptuous; that if the Government ... hoped I would furnish the means, the request would be favorably considered. Then I said I could never act in the matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exercise humility when proposing transformative public works—prefer to respond to legitimate institutional requests rather than unilaterally imposing large-scale projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measure philanthropic success by beneficiary impact rather than publicity
rubrics_metrics.description: It is a true romance, which no air-castle can quite equal or fiction conceive. ... This is the crowning mercy of my career! I set it apart from all my other public gifts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize lasting, tangible benefits to beneficiaries (e.g., public enjoyment of a park, improved living conditions) over donor recognition; use beneficiary outcomes as the primary metric of success.
